sections.appearance: She has long brown hair reaching her legs, tied into two short pigtails. She has lavender eyes. Halo ==== Shizuko's halo has two pastel pink hearts with circles merging together inside another circle with triangles on the sides. Uniform ==== She wears a "traditional Japanese maid" outfit inspired by [https://blog.buyee.jp/taisho-era-japan-2/ Taisho Era] mogu fashion, a pink kimono with flowery patterns, a long skirt, and a maid apron with stitched pink hearts. She also wears knee-high white socks and a thick wooden geta, alongside a maid headdress with a pink bow. Gym: She was wearing a white athletic T-shirt with a pink collar and cuffs, pink shorts with a white stripe down the sides, and pink shoes with white soles. Firearm ==== thumb|Sakura Bon Bon|150px She uses a black Ithaca 37 pump-action shotgun with a wooden furniture and fore-end. Several small flower decals are imprinted on the fore-end. The weapon's name is stamped on the left side of the receiver.

sections.personality: Shizuko on the surface has a friendly and calm personality mixed with aspects of being an idol like image. However, beneath the surface there are cracks in her personality as she can get vindictive and aggressive when provoked.
